metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over northern part of Isabela Island greater than the southern part of Isabela Island at 1:20 am local time on January 7, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nighttime brightness comparison between northern and southern parts of Isabela Island at a specific time (1:20 am local time on January 7, 2022). This requires: 1. Data: VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) data for nighttime lights 2. Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or similar 3. Time: January 7, 2022 (specific time might be approximated since satellite data has fixed overpass times) 4. Location: Isabela Island, split into northern and southern parts 5. Processing: Compare average radiance values between the two regions Key considerations: - VIIRS DNB provides nighttime brightness data - Need to split Isabela Island into northern and southern regions - Check if data exists for that specific date - Compare average radiance values - Handle potential data gaps or cloud cover Let me structure this: 1. Define geometry for Isabela Island and split into northern/southern parts 2. Get VIIRS DNB data for the specified date 3. Check if collection is empty (C1) 4. Extract average radiance for both regions 5. Check if valid pixels exist (C2) 6. Compare values and determine if northern part is brighter 7. Handle calculation failures (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Isabela Island geometry (Galapagos) const isabelaIsland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-91.15, -0.35], [-91.45, -0.35], [-91.45, -1.0], [-91.15, -1.0], [-91.15, -0.35] ]); // Split into northern and southern parts const northernPart = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-91.15, -0.35], [-91.45, -0.35], [-91.45, -0.675], [-91.15, -0.675], [-91.15, -0.35] ]); const southernPart = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-91.15, -0.675], [-91.45, -0.675], [-91.45, -1.0], [-91.15, -1.0], [-91.15, -0.675] ]); // Get VIIRS DNB nighttime lights data const startDate = '2022-01-07'; const endDate = '2022-01-08'; const viirsCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(isabelaIsland); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = viirsCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS Images Found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the image and extract radiance band const image = viirsCollection.first(); // Calculate average radiance for northern and southern parts const northStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northernPart, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const southStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernPart, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const northCount = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northernPart, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const southCount = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southernPart, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`North Pixels: ${northCount}, South Pixels: ${southCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (northCount === 0 || southCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Get radiance values const northRadiance = northStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const southRadiance = southStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`North Radiance: ${northRadiance ? northRadiance.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); console.log(`South Radiance: ${southRadiance ? southRadiance.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); // Check for calculation failures if (northRadiance === null || southRadiance === null || isNaN(northRadiance) || isNaN(southRadiance) || northRadiance < 0 || southRadiance < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare radiance values if (northRadiance > southRadiance) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
